name: @activepieces/piece-qwilr
description: Create beautiful, interactive sales documents and proposals with Qwilr. Automate page creation, track views, and handle acceptance events.

auth.description:
1. Go to your Qwilr account settings.
    2. Navigate to API Settings.
    3. Copy your access token.

create_page.name: create_page
create_page.description: Creates a new Qwilr page from saved blocks or template.

templateId.description: ID of the template to use for the page

name.description: Title of the page, visible as the browser page title

published.description: Whether the page is publicly available; false means the page will be in Draft status

ownerId.description: ID of the user that should own the page. If not specified, the owner of the access token will be the owner of the page.

tags.description: The tags for your page. Tags are case-sensitive.

metadata.description: Data you provide, that will be returned as part of all Webhooks.

substitutions.description: Mapping of token API reference keys to substitution values used throughout the page.

acceptSettings.description: Configures settings for the accept block in the template being used. Only relevant if you have an accept block.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new Qwilr sales/proposal page from an existing template (template ID required), optionally publishing it live or leaving it as a draft, and applying token substitutions, tags, owner, and accept-block settings. Use to programmatically generate a personalized proposal or quote from a template. Not idempotent: each call creates a separate page.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

auth.description:
1. Go to your Qwilr account settings.
    2. Navigate to API Settings.
    3. Copy your access token.

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

auth.description:
1. Go to your Qwilr account settings.
    2. Navigate to API Settings.
    3. Copy your access token.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

page_accepted.name: page_accepted
page_accepted.description: Triggers when a Qwilr page is accepted

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a recipient fully accepts a Qwilr page (all accept blocks signed off), signaling the proposal or quote has been agreed to. Use to kick off downstream deal-won workflows such as invoicing or CRM updates.

page_partially_accepted.name: page_partially_accepted
page_partially_accepted.description: Triggers when a Qwilr page is partially accepted

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a recipient partially accepts a Qwilr page (some but not all accept blocks completed), indicating partial agreement on a multi-option proposal. Use to track in-progress deals or nudge for full acceptance.

page_preview_accepted.name: page_preview_accepted
page_preview_accepted.description: Triggers when a Qwilr page preview is accepted

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a page is accepted while in preview (test) mode rather than as a live recipient acceptance. Use to validate acceptance workflows during testing without reacting to a real signed proposal.

page_viewed.name: page_viewed
page_viewed.description: Triggers when a Qwilr page is viewed

aiMetadata.description: Fires every time a Qwilr page is opened by a viewer, including repeat views. Use to track engagement on a sent proposal; for only the very first open use the Page First Viewed trigger instead.

page_first_viewed.name: page_first_viewed
page_first_viewed.description: Triggers when a Qwilr page is viewed for the first time

aiMetadata.description: Fires only on the first time a Qwilr page is opened by a viewer, marking initial engagement with a sent proposal. Use to react once to a recipient first opening the document; for all subsequent opens use the Page Viewed trigger.

page_set_live.name: page_set_live
page_set_live.description: Triggers when a Qwilr page is set to live

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a Qwilr page is published and set to live (made publicly accessible), transitioning out of draft status. Use to react when a proposal becomes ready to share with a recipient.

page_revived_live.name: page_revived_live
page_revived_live.description: Triggers when a Qwilr page is revived to live status

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a previously disabled or expired Qwilr page is revived back to live status, making it accessible again. Use to react when an old proposal is reactivated for a recipient.

nl.Create beautiful, interactive sales docu: Maak mooie, interactieve verkoopdocumenten en voorstellen met Qwilr. Automatiseer pagina creatie, track weergave en afhandelen van acceptatie-gebeurtenissen.
nl.\n 1. Go to your Qwilr account settin:
1. Ga naar je Qwilr account instellingen.
    2. Navigeer naar API instellingen.
    3. Kopieer je toegangstoken.
nl.Creates a new Qwilr page from saved bloc: Maakt een nieuwe Qwilr pagina van opgeslagen blokken of sjabloon.
nl.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Maak een aangepaste API call naar een specifiek eindpunt
nl.ID of the template to use for the page: ID van het te gebruiken sjabloon voor de pagina
nl.Title of the page, visible as the browse: Titel van de pagina, zichtbaar als de browserpaginatitel
nl.Whether the page is publicly available;: Of de pagina openbaar is beschikbaar; onjuist betekent dat de pagina in de ontwerpstatus is
ID van de gebruiker die eigenaar moet zijn van de pagina. Indien niet opgegeven, zal de eigenaar van het toegangstoken de pagina zijn.
nl.The tags for your page. Tags are case-se: De tags van je pagina. Tags zijn hoofdlettergevoelig.
nl.Data you provide, that will be returned: Gegevens die je opgeeft, worden geretourneerd als onderdeel van alle webhooks.
nl.Mapping of token API reference keys to s: Toewijzing van token API referentie sleutels naar vervangingswaarden die worden gebruikt op de hele pagina.
nl.Configures settings for the accept block: Configureert instellingen voor het accepteren blok in het sjabloon dat wordt gebruikt. Alleen relevant als je een blok accepteert.
nl.Authorization headers are injected autom: Autorisatie headers worden automatisch geïnjecteerd vanuit uw verbinding.
Inschakelen voor bestanden zoals PDF's, afbeeldingen etc.
nl.HEAD: HOOFD
nl.Triggers when a Qwilr page is accepted: Triggert wanneer een Qwilr pagina wordt geaccepteerd
nl.Triggers when a Qwilr page is partially: Triggert wanneer een Qwilr pagina gedeeltelijk wordt geaccepteerd
nl.Triggers when a Qwilr page preview is ac: Triggert wanneer een voorbeeld van de Qwilr wordt geaccepteerd
nl.Triggers when a Qwilr page is viewed: Activeert wanneer een Qwilr pagina wordt bekeken
nl.Triggers when a Qwilr page is viewed for: Triggert wanneer een Qwilr pagina voor de eerste keer wordt bekeken
nl.Triggers when a Qwilr page is set to liv: Activeert wanneer een Qwilr pagina is ingesteld op live
nl.Triggers when a Qwilr page is revived to: Triggert wanneer een Qwilr pagina wordt herleid tot live status

de.Create beautiful, interactive sales docu: Erstellen Sie mit Qwilr wunderschöne, interaktive Verkaufsunterlagen und -vorschläge und automatisieren Sie die Seitenerstellung, die Ansichten und den Umgang mit Akzeptanzen.
de.\n 1. Go to your Qwilr account settin:
1. Gehen Sie zu Ihren Qwilr Konto-Einstellungen.
    2. Navigieren Sie zu den API-Einstellungen.
    3. Kopieren Sie Ihr Zugangs-Token.
de.Creates a new Qwilr page from saved bloc: Erstellt eine neue Qwilr-Seite aus gespeicherten Blöcken oder Vorlagen.
de.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Einen benutzerdefinierten API-Aufruf an einen bestimmten Endpunkt machen
de.ID of the template to use for the page: ID der für die Seite zu verwendenden Vorlage
de.Title of the page, visible as the browse: Titel der Seite, sichtbar als Browser-Seitentitel
de.Whether the page is publicly available;: Ob die Seite öffentlich verfügbar ist; falsch bedeutet, dass die Seite im Entwurfsstatus ist
ID des Benutzers, der die Seite besitzen soll. Wenn nicht angegeben, ist der Besitzer des Zugriffstoken der Besitzer der Seite.
de.The tags for your page. Tags are case-se: Die Tags für Ihre Seite. Die Tags berücksichtigen Groß- und Kleinschreibung.
de.Data you provide, that will be returned: Die von Ihnen angegebenen Daten, die als Teil aller Webhooks zurückgegeben werden.
de.Mapping of token API reference keys to s: Zuordnung von Token API-Referenzschlüssel zu Ersetzungswerten, die auf der Seite verwendet werden.
de.Configures settings for the accept block: Konfiguriert die Einstellungen für den "Akzeptieren"-Baustein in der zu verwendenden Vorlage. Nur relevant, wenn du einen "Akzeptieren"-Baustein hast.
de.Authorization headers are injected autom: Autorisierungs-Header werden automatisch von Ihrer Verbindung injiziert.
Aktivieren für Dateien wie PDFs, Bilder usw.
de.HEAD: HEAD
de.Triggers when a Qwilr page is accepted: Wird ausgelöst, wenn eine Qwilr-Seite akzeptiert wird
de.Triggers when a Qwilr page is partially: Löst aus, wenn eine Qwilr-Seite teilweise akzeptiert wird
de.Triggers when a Qwilr page preview is ac: Wird ausgelöst, wenn eine Qwilr-Seitenvorschau akzeptiert wird
de.Triggers when a Qwilr page is viewed: Wird ausgelöst, wenn eine Qwilr-Seite angezeigt wird
de.Triggers when a Qwilr page is viewed for: Wird ausgelöst, wenn zum ersten Mal eine Qwilr-Seite angezeigt wird
de.Triggers when a Qwilr page is set to liv: Löst aus, wenn eine Qwilr-Seite auf Live gesetzt wird
de.Triggers when a Qwilr page is revived to: Löst aus, wenn eine Qwilr-Seite zum Live-Status wiederbelebt wird

fr.Create beautiful, interactive sales docu: Créez de beaux documents de vente interactifs et des propositions avec Qwilr. Automatisez la création de pages, suivez les vues et gérez les événements d'acceptation.
fr.\n 1. Go to your Qwilr account settin:
1. Go to your Qwilr account settings.
    2. Navigate to API Settings.
    3. Copy your access token.

fr.ID of the template to use for the page: ID du modèle à utiliser pour la page

es.Create beautiful, interactive sales docu: Cree hermosos y interactivos documentos de ventas y propuestas con Qwilr. Automatiza la creación de páginas, las vistas de seguimiento y gestiona los eventos de aceptación.
es.\n 1. Go to your Qwilr account settin:
1. Vaya a la configuración de su cuenta Qwilr
    2. Navegue a la configuración de la API.
    3. Copie su token de acceso.
es.Creates a new Qwilr page from saved bloc: Crea una nueva página Qwilr desde bloques guardados o plantilla.
es.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Hacer una llamada API personalizada a un extremo específico
es.No Error on Failure: No hay ningún error en fallo
es.ID of the template to use for the page: ID de la plantilla a usar para la página
es.Title of the page, visible as the browse: Título de la página, visible como título de la página del navegador
es.Whether the page is publicly available;: Si la página está disponible públicamente; falso significa que la página estará en estado de borrador

es.Data you provide, that will be returned: Datos que usted proporciona, que serán devueltos como parte de todos los Webhooks.
es.Mapping of token API reference keys to s: Mapeo de claves de referencia de token API a los valores de sustitución utilizados en toda la página.
es.Configures settings for the accept block: Configura la configuración del bloque aceptar en la plantilla que se está usando. Sólo es relevante si tienes un bloque aceptado.
es.Authorization headers are injected autom: Las cabeceras de autorización se inyectan automáticamente desde tu conexión.

es.Triggers when a Qwilr page is partially: Dispara cuando una página Qwilr es parcialmente aceptada
es.Triggers when a Qwilr page preview is ac: Dispara cuando se acepta una vista previa de página Qwilr
es.Triggers when a Qwilr page is viewed: Dispara cuando se ve una página Qwilr
es.Triggers when a Qwilr page is viewed for: Dispara cuando una página Qwilr es vista por primera vez
es.Triggers when a Qwilr page is set to liv: Dispara cuando una página Qwilr está configurada en vivo
es.Triggers when a Qwilr page is revived to: Dispara cuando una página Qwilr es reanimada para revivir el estado
